setup: A dilation with factor \([[factor]]\) is applied to a segment whose length is given.

steps.say: A dilation moves every point along the ray from the centre and multiplies its distance from the centre by the factor, so it multiplies every length by \([[factor]]\) and leaves every angle alone.
The image is similar to the original, so the shape is unchanged and only the size moves: \([[length]]\) is the whole of the answer, with no second step.

answer: So the image of the segment has length \([[length]]\).
